title: Optional: Runtime Budget Review
briefing: Run the first warning-state check so the prototype explains runtime and optional-module posture before heavier factory systems arrive.
fieldGuide: This is an optional side mission. It teaches where warning states, subtle UI sounds, and RuntimeGuard notes appear, while keeping all budgets generic until Pack #2 has heavier automation to measure.

objectives.label: Deep Scan the Hand Crank Generator
objectives.detail: Scan the generator after the starter loop has been checked.

objectives.label: Read the budget note
objectives.detail: Open the Runtime Budget Index entry or Terminal warning-state panel.

rewards.label: Runtime Budget Intel
rewards.detail: Unlocks the warning-state and troubleshooting notes for the prototype route.

metadata.nextObjective: Continue the main route at Processor Worksite or Depot Request calibration.
metadata.completionFeedback: Runtime posture reviewed. This side check is complete.
